cover: Diplomatic talks begin in Abu Dhabi as Middle East conflict shifts
cover_scene: An imposing international negotiation table flanked by American, Ukrainian, and Russian flags inside an Abu Dhabi conference hall under soft morning light

slides.scene: Delegates seated along an expansive wooden summit table inside a modern Abu Dhabi palace hall with ornate arched windows
slides.headline: Russia and Ukraine Open Abu Dhabi Talks
slides.body: Russian and Ukrainian officials convened in Abu Dhabi for US-mediated negotiations following Donald Trump's signal that a settlement is possible. The delegations are discussing a new security framework to de-escalate the war after months of stalled diplomacy.

slides.scene: A Parisian government ministry room illuminated by television camera lights with French and European Union flags standing behind an empty podium
slides.headline: France Pledges Retaliation Over Iranian Cyberattack
slides.body: The French government vowed a firm response after attributing a major cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration infrastructure to Iranian state actors. Officials condemned the breach of critical food supply networks and are preparing formal retaliatory measures.

slides.scene: The illuminated dome of the United States Capitol at night behind the empty mahogany dais of a congressional chamber
slides.headline: Pentagon Chief Hegseth Faces Impeachment Effort
slides.body: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth faces an impeachment bid in Congress, placing the Pentagon chief under intense legislative scrutiny. Lawmakers have initiated proceedings amid mounting political friction in Washington, setting up a high-stakes standoff on Capitol Hill.

slides.scene: A bustling East Asian container shipping port at sunset with towering cranes loading cargo vessels flying Chinese flags
slides.headline: China Trade Growth Surges Past Forecasts
slides.body: China reported a 35.2% jump in October exports and a 41.6% rise in imports, easily beating market expectations. While surging imports narrowed the monthly surplus, China's annual trade surplus topped $1 trillion, underscoring resilient global manufacturing demand.

slides.scene: A modern European football stadium glittering under night floodlights with a polished silver trophy on a central pedestal amidst falling confetti
slides.headline: UEFA Expands Women Champions League Prize Fund
slides.body: UEFA unveiled an 18.2 million euro prize pot for the 2026-27 Women's Champions League, alongside 7.7 million euros for qualifying rounds. The governing body will also distribute millions in solidarity payments to national football associations to boost the sport.
